dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge (posterior) exhibits a sharp concave curvature with a prominent irregular notch or tissue loss located approximately midway between the apex and the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is acute and sharply defined, characterized by a minimal pixel radius and a pointed convergence of the margins.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a long, gradual slope at an angle of approximately 25 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The dorsal fin displays a low-profile aspect with a base width-to-height ratio of approximately 2.8:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon exhibits a low-amplitude convexity with a wide radius, merging smoothly from the dorsal line with minimal vertical elevation.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: The rostrum is exceptionally elongated and slender, extending horizontally with a high length-to-thickness pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A subtle but measurable concave inflection is visible at the pixel coordinate where the gradual melon slope meets the linear rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; extensive white stippling and small punctate depigmentation marks are visible along the mid-to-lower flank and the posterior fin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely slender cranio-rostral silhouette and a unique high-density white speckled pigmentation pattern against the dark integument.
